title: Establish purchasing foundation
objective: Implement Company/Branch-scoped Vendor and purchase-order identity, lifecycle, authorization, repository, API, and audit evidence without writing Inventory or Accounting-owned persistence.

repository.name: ACP-Enterprise
repository.start_rule: Fetch origin, record current authoritative SHA and sole Alembic head, and create a new isolated worktree only after separate Owner Start.

ownership.purchasing: Vendor operational identity, purchase orders, lines, lifecycle, approval boundary, and purchasing audit evidence.
ownership.inventory: Items, locations, quantities, reservations, movements, receipts into stock, and all Inventory tables. PUR.1 may reference accepted public identities but may not write them.
ownership.accounting: Vendor financial identity/mapping, AP bills, journals, control accounts, periods, and financial statements.
ownership.receiving: Deferred to PUR.2; PUR.1 does not receive stock or post Inventory movements.

migration.parent_rule: Immediately before integration, fetch origin/customer-management-v1 and descend from its sole current Alembic head. No sibling head or merge revision.
migration.reparent_rule: Mechanical only before publication and only when DDL, data, runtime, and downgrade semantics are unchanged; otherwise STOP.

validation: idempotency, optimistic concurrency, and immutable audit events
prove no direct Inventory or Accounting persistence writes
focused backend/frontend tests, Ruff, MyPy, ESLint, TypeScript/Vite build
fresh Alembic upgrade, drift check, and exactly one head
git diff --check and focused secret/private-key scan
stop_conditions: Preview, Production, deployment, cutover, or irreversible operation
start_authority: Separate Owner Start required; this packet does not Start PUR.1.
